name: Geek Chic
summary: The trend represented a significant cultural shift where elements once associated with being "uncool" or socially awkward were recontextualized as fashionable.
description: The trend represented a significant cultural shift where elements once associated with being "uncool" or socially awkward were recontextualized as fashionable. Geek Chic is not about being an actual geek in terms of interests, but about adopting the visual style of the archetype as a style statement. [ 2 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Intelligence as fashion, irony, nostalgia (for school uniforms), subverting stereotypes
